title: 08 weir: a Bauhaus hero for a data-pipeline company
strengths: The geometry is the pipeline: databases, event streams and SaaS apps as Kandinsky's blue circle, yellow triangle and red square, sized by rows a day (1.6 b, 0.62 b, 0.18 b); bars weighted by rows a second into a vertical weir bar and a black warehouse square (2.4 b rows a day, 0 lost)
One geometric family (Jost) in lowercase, regular weight with one bold phrase; vertical type along the weir bar; one red action
Placed on a 12-column grid with specific facts: 312 connectors, 4 min p95 lag, eu or us residency
slop_signals: The hero recipe: 'every row in. / none lost.' with the second line bold, a red button plus an underlined 'read the docs', then three stat columns
The shapes float apart at even spacing with no overlap, cropping or diagonal, so it reads as a slide diagram rather than a Bauhaus composition (the builder notes the same)
The vertical label 'weir · checks every row against its source' set inside a thin bar is hard to read
fixes: Compose with tension: let the circle, square and triangle interlock and bleed off the frame, as in the Friends of Figma section, with the flows still weighted by rows a second
Lock the headline to a bar or a shape edge and drop the three-stat row or fold it into the diagram
Set the weir's job horizontally beside the bar

references.what: Half circles, a triangle and squares that interlock and fill the frame
Flat geometric shapes on a primary field beside a plain headline
Shapes scattered around a centred headline: the decorative version to avoid

changed: Rebuilt as a poster with tension: a black crest bar holding the one-line headline joins the vertical weir bar; both bleed off the frame
Circle, square and triangle interlock and bleed, still sized by rows a day (80,000 px2 per billion: r 202, side 120, side 338.5); warehouse side 438, whole, flush in the corner
Flow bars weighted by rows a second (16 + 6 + 2 = 24 px; 18,500 + 7,200 + 2,100 = 27,800 = 2.4 b over 86,400 s); the databases bar has a paper edge on the blue
Weir's job set horizontally beside the bar; the three-stat row folded into it and into the warehouse (p95 4 min)
One black action; red marks only the saas square apart from the logo and focus ring
312 connectors replaced by 287 (312 is used elsewhere); SVG after the copy in source order with a full aria-label; engine pick Q-dir-01 bauhaus
